Broad national record: 5,815 acts in force from Slov-Lex as their current consolidated text (aktuálne znenie) plus the Constitution and the election act with dated in-force history, and all eight essential codes held at their 2025-2026 versions (Trestný zákon includes the 2024 changes). Only the Constitution and the election act have history; no case law is held, and the README's English summary still says 664 acts.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
